name: mirage
text: Yes. If the buyer loses, you keep their stake and your collateral is released back to you: e.g. the first card shows +$4.75 (their stake) and your $5.13 comes back. If the buyer wins, you pay out the collateral (-$5.13 there) and lose it; their stake is returned to them too. So 'If buyer loses +$X' is pure profit on top of getting your collateral back. Note the wallet is $0.05 and the red banner says STOPPED 12:58 PM, so nothing new is quoted until you tap Resume. Those open parlays settle on their own.
